descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家已经到达星门物体以不可置信的速度坠毁到[From.Planet.GetName]上的撞击地点。

毫无疑问，从撞击点的外表来看，这绝不是一次普通的坠毁着陆，我们的科学家期待进行进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
Our scientist have reached the impact site of the object from the gateway that crashed into [From.Planet.GetName] at incredible speed.

It's clear from the look of the impact site that this was no ordinary crash landing, and our scientists are eager to investigate further.

descriptions.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
descriptions.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

sections.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
sections.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

descriptions.zh: 此前发现的外星指示器指向了这颗行星，我们应该下到其表面进行进一步的调查。
descriptions.en: The previously discovered alien indicators are pointing at this planet, and we should go down on the surface and investigate further.

sections.zh: 此前发现的外星指示器指向了这颗行星，我们应该下到其表面进行进一步的调查。
sections.en: The previously discovered alien indicators are pointing at this planet, and we should go down on the surface and investigate further.

descriptions.zh: 我们的扫描仪侦测到有东西在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表深处。
descriptions.en: Our scanners have picked up something deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

sections.zh: 我们的扫描仪侦测到有东西在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表深处。
sections.en: Our scanners have picked up something deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 显然，我们的神秘施恩者觉得地下结构是个很时髦的概念。
descriptions.en: Underground structures are apparently a popular motif amongst our mysterious Benefactors.

sections.zh: 显然，我们的神秘施恩者觉得地下结构是个很时髦的概念。
sections.en: Underground structures are apparently a popular motif amongst our mysterious Benefactors.

descriptions.zh: 扫描仪从轨道上读取的数据表明下方的行星上存在一个人工构造。但与以前的不同，该构造并未埋于地下。
descriptions.en: Scanner readings from orbit indicate that there is a structure down on the planet. Unlike the previous ones, this one is not buried underground.

sections.zh: 扫描仪从轨道上读取的数据表明下方的行星上存在一个人工构造。但与以前的不同，该构造并未埋于地下。
sections.en: Scanner readings from orbit indicate that there is a structure down on the planet. Unlike the previous ones, this one is not buried underground.

descriptions.zh: 坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]上的某处，但进一步的扫描没有发现任何异常。
descriptions.en: The coordinates point to an arbitrary spot down on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Closer scans indicate nothing out of the ordinary.

sections.zh: 坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]上的某处，但进一步的扫描没有发现任何异常。
sections.en: The coordinates point to an arbitrary spot down on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Closer scans indicate nothing out of the ordinary.

descriptions.zh: 我们找了个合适的位置为未来某天重返星空的特瓦'菲亚埋下了这些储备。一份前往未来的礼物，送给过去的巨人。
descriptions.en: We have found a good location to bury the cache intended for the Thwaa'Phyr as they one day take to the stars anew. A gift in the future, to giants of the past.

sections.zh: 我们找了个合适的位置为未来某天重返星空的特瓦'菲亚埋下了这些储备。一份前往未来的礼物，送给过去的巨人。
sections.en: We have found a good location to bury the cache intended for the Thwaa'Phyr as they one day take to the stars anew. A gift in the future, to giants of the past.

descriptions.zh: 考古部门将这里作为一个完美的地址，用于埋藏资料，以供给将来“迈入太空时代”的无情者后裔。
descriptions.en: This spot has been chosen by the archaeology department as a perfect site to bury assets for the Relentless descendants when they 'come of space age'.

sections.zh: 考古部门将这里作为一个完美的地址，用于埋藏资料，以供给将来“迈入太空时代”的无情者后裔。
sections.en: This spot has been chosen by the archaeology department as a perfect site to bury assets for the Relentless descendants when they 'come of space age'.

descriptions.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
descriptions.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a similar noise. Whatever could be behind these singular phenomena?
